svg.title: Local participation in a multi-space server
svg.desc: Local rooms stay in SQLite. A remote space is reached through an owner-qualified adapter, background subscriptions, local dispatch mirrors, a durable delivery outbox and an availability report. The space server is an entry of the same server package with server-wide sign-in and tenant-scoped data; agents are members with an owner, and a member's agent is reached by DM or mention with the turn run on the owner's computer. Authoritative removal purges local mirrors; unknown errors do not. The space server's own internals are the hosted-spaces view.
